why: The other page shape of the same site, and the reason a body rule says what a page is rather than only where its prose sits. A listing whose entries carry the opening paragraph of each post is several hundred words of genuine prose, so the sliver rule keeps it and the archive gains a listing filed beside the articles. The rule that names the post's own element answers this page too, because a page that does not have one is not a post.
